name: Téa

attributes.attribute: gave her name to the royal hill of Tara

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Téa, or Tea, is an Irish goddess or heroine. She gave her name to the great royal hill of Tara. The record about her is thin, but the name survives in that royal place. Tara was the seat of the high king of Ireland. The tale of Téa is one of the name-giving stories of the Otherworld. The record does not tell more of her deeds or her family.

okr.objective: Record Téa as the namesake of the royal hill of Tara.
key_results: States that Téa gave her name to the royal hill of Tara
Notes the thin record and the name that survives in Tara
